in_sanskrit.name: Shakti
in_sanskrit.meaning: Power, Energy, Fertility, Creativity, Intensity, Shakti Goddess
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The divine feminine energy or power, responsible for creation and destruction, and the source of all life and energy. Worshipped as a goddess in Hinduism.

in_hindi.name: शक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: शक्ति (Shakti) is a Sanskrit word meaning power, energy, or capability. It is also the name of the goddess Shakti, who represents the divine feminine power and energy in Hinduism.

in_tamil.name: சக்தி
in_tamil.long_meaning: சக்தி (Cakti) is a Tamil word meaning power or energy. It is also the name of the goddess Cakti, who is revered in Tamil Hinduism as the embodiment of divine feminine power and energy.

in_telugu.name: శక్తి
in_telugu.long_meaning: శక్తి (Shakti) is a Telugu word meaning power or energy. It is also the name of the goddess Shakti, who is revered in Telugu Hinduism as the embodiment of divine feminine power and energy.

in_marathi.name: Shakthi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Power
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shakthi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The goddess Shakti represents the divine feminine, the creative force in the universe, and the power that lies within all beings.

in_bengali.name: Shakthi
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Goddess of Power
in_bengali.long_meaning: Shakthi একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The goddess Shakti represents the divine feminine, the creative force in the universe, and the power that lies within all beings.
